```{python}
#| output: False
from FISCAS_Validator import Validator, CellType
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import random
import copy
import os
from IPython.display import HTML, display, SVG

def convert_to_float_and_round(value, decimal=4):
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [convert_to_float_and_round(item) for item in value]
    elif isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        return np.array([convert_to_float_and_round(item) for item in value])
    else:
        return round(float(value), decimal)
```

```{python}
#| output: False
if seed == 0:
    seed = random.randint(1, 10000)
random.seed(seed)
np.random.seed(seed)
parameters_A = {"path" : "./Cell_Library/DLD-1",
                mass_list[0] : ["normal", 15, 5], 
                mass_list[1] : ["normal", 22, 5],
                mass_list[2] : ["normal", 9, 5],
                mass_list[3] : ["normal", 15, 5]
                }
parameters_B = {"path" : "./Cell_Library/Colo205",
                mass_list[0] : ["normal", 15, 5], 
                mass_list[1] : ["normal", 10, 3],
                mass_list[2] : ["normal", 40, 15],
                mass_list[3] : ["normal", 0, 1]    
                }

A = CellType("A", parameters_A, 0.6)
B = CellType("B", parameters_B, 0.4)

cell_types=[A,B]

A = Validator(
    output=output,
    use_perfect_segmentation=use_perfect_segmentation, 
    use_perfect_registration=use_perfect_registration, 
    remove_ambiguous=remove_ambiguous,
    seed=seed, 
    scale=scale, 
    teaching_imprecision=teaching_imprecision, 
    rotation=rotation, 
    ms_spacing=ms_spacing, 
    plot=plot, 
    save_img=save_img, 
    canvas_size=canvas_size, 
    cell_density=cell_density, 
    mass_list=mass_list,
    cell_types = cell_types,
    diffusion_total_time=diffusion_total_time,
    diffusion_dt=diffusion_dt,
    diffusion_coeff=diffusion_coeff,
    diffusion_barrier_alpha=diffusion_barrier_alpha,
    diffusion_leaky_outer_boundary=diffusion_leaky_outer_boundary,
    texture=texture,
    texture_path=texture_path,
    texture_epsilon_add=texture_epsilon_add,
    texture_epsilon_multiply=texture_epsilon_multiply)

canvas_metrics, registration_metrics, segmentation_metrics, spectra_metrics, cluster_metrics = A.main()
mass_list = A.mass_list
```

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame(list(spectra_metrics.items()), columns=['Key', 'Value'])
df2 = pd.DataFrame(df.loc[~df['Key'].isin(["time", "FPR"]), 'Value'].to_list(), columns=[mz for mz in mass_list])
df2 = df2.fillna(0)
df2.insert(0, 'Metric', df.loc[~df['Key'].isin(["time", "FPR"]), 'Key'].to_list())
for mz in mass_list:
    df2[mz] = df2[mz].apply(convert_to_float_and_round, decimal=2)
html_table = df2.to_html(index=False, header=True )
display(HTML(html_table))
print(f"mean FPR is {spectra_metrics['FPR']:.2f}%")
#print(f"Spectra compilation took {spectra_metrics['time']} s")
```

```{python}
setting_columns = list(settings.keys())
columns = copy.copy(setting_columns)
parameters = ["MRE X", "STD MRE X", "MRE Y", "STD MRE Y", "m/z 0", "STD m/z 0", "m/z 1", "STD m/z 1", "m/z 2", "STD m/z 2", "m/z 3", "STD m/z 3", "FPR", "ARI"]
for param in parameters:
    columns.append(param)
df = pd.DataFrame(columns=columns)
values = []
for setting_value in settings.values():
    values.append(setting_value)

for i in range(2):
    values.append(float(registration_metrics['mre'][i]))
    values.append(float(registration_metrics['mre_std'][i]))

for i in range(4):
    values.append(float(spectra_metrics['spectra_mean_deviation'][i]))
    values.append(float(spectra_metrics['spectra_deviation_variance'][i]))

values.append(float(spectra_metrics['FPR']))
values.append(float(cluster_metrics['adjusted_rand_index']))
df = pd.concat([df, pd.DataFrame([values], columns=df.columns)], ignore_index=True)
df.to_csv(f"./output/summary/results_summary_{settings['ID']}.csv", index=False)
```

```{python}
setting_columns = list(settings.keys())
columns = copy.copy(setting_columns)
parameters = ["MRE X", "STD MRE X", "MRE Y", "STD MRE Y", "m/z 0", "STD m/z 0", "m/z 1", "STD m/z 1", "m/z 2", "STD m/z 2", "m/z 3", "STD m/z 3", "FPR", "ARI"]
for param in parameters:
    columns.append(param)

for i in range(2):
    values.append(float(registration_metrics['mre'][i]))

for i in range(4):
    values.append(float(spectra_metrics['spectra_mean_deviation'][i]))
    values.append(np.sqrt(float(spectra_metrics['spectra_deviation_variance'][i])))

values.append(float(spectra_metrics['FPR']))
values.append(float(cluster_metrics['adjusted_rand_index']))
```
